decisions.reason: Restricting the selectable theme palette does not change bullet sizing, spacing, alignment, or the fixed green fourth-level bullet requirement.
The palette restriction does not affect Tab-based list hierarchy or its unresolved interaction behavior.
The selectable color restriction does not change any current font size, weight, family, style, or line-spacing attribute.
The theme color palette does not affect numbered-list alignment at double-digit values.
The palette clause is independent of the Board Meeting behavior for inserting lines after a Topic.
Restricting available colors does not change the date-picker method or its template contexts.
The palette restriction does not change fixed-margin or pencil-icon containment behavior.
Available theme colors do not affect multiline entry or hard-return paragraph spacing.
The color-palette decision does not change placeholder clearing behavior in control fields.
Restricting selectable theme colors does not necessarily change legacy copy-paste layout or style stability.
The palette restriction does not affect table containment or column stability during paste.
The source decision restricts available colors but does not alter Danish style names, field labels, or placeholder text.
